author: GamingBolt
description:
It was a day like any other in October 2019. Cars drove by the Federal Bureau of Control's HQ, known as the Oldest House, as they do. Such was the lack of eventfulness, the feeling of “same old, same old,” that few would have noticed no one at the desk of the Bureau. Or at the metal detectors. 

The lobby was empty, save for one individual who passed through the automatic doors and walked the shiny floor – Jesse Faden.
title: The Full Story of Control - Before You Play CONTROL Resonant

author: GamingBolt
description: Minecraft Dungeons II is expanding the dungeon-crawling formula of its predecessor in meaningful ways. From a newly interconnected world to deeper buildcrafting, new equipment options, and a host of co-op improvements, there’s plenty here to familiarise yourself with before you embark on this upcoming adventure sequel. Here are fourteen things you need to know before you buy Minecraft Dungeons II.
title: Minecraft Dungeons 2: 14 Things You NEED To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Control Resonant is clearly bigger than its predecessor, but its most meaningful changes aren’t necessarily the obvious ones. Rather than providing another jaunt through the supernatural, with a new protagonist, setting, and combat systems, Resonant is reshaping how Control actually works and how it feels to play. 

From objectives that can be tackled in different orders, to enemies that harbour distinct combat roles, this is a world showcasing significant differences between Control and Control Resonant. Here are ten of the biggest that you need to know.
title: Control Resonant vs Control - 10 BIGGEST Differences
